request: Add job cancellation, automatic retries for failed jobs, and recovery after a process restart to this job runner. Expose cancellation and retry status through the REST API and show them on the web dashboard. Follow the behaviour specified in SPEC.md.

nodes.title: Contract: states, job fields, errors, cancel and backoff
nodes.goal: This is the contract every other sub-task builds on; follow SPEC.md for names, types, and defaults. Give each new name a docstring. In jobrunner/models.py add JobStatus.CANCELLED (final) and the Job fields attempts=0, max_attempts=3, next_run_at=0.0, last_error=None, cancel_requested=False, included in Job.to_dict. In jobrunner/errors.py add TransientError and InvalidTransition. In jobrunner/store.py fill the new Job fields from the existing progress columns and make claim add 1 to attempts. In jobrunner/retry.py add the complete helper backoff_delay(base_delay, failures) = base_delay * 2 ** (failures - 1) (leave decide unchanged). Create jobrunner/cancellation.py with request_cancel(store, job_id) -> Job: a default that cancels PENDING jobs, raises InvalidTransition for final jobs and JobNotFound for unknown ids; add Runner.cancel delegating to it. Write tests/test_contract.py.

nodes.title: Retry policy and due-time scheduling
nodes.goal: Implement SPEC.md 'Retries' in jobrunner/retry.py decide: a TransientError sends the job back to PENDING with next_run_at = now + backoff_delay(base_delay, job.attempts) while job.attempts < job.max_attempts, otherwise FAILED; any other exception is FAILED at once; the outcome carries the error message. In jobrunner/scheduler.py make pick_next return only PENDING jobs with next_run_at <= now, earliest next_run_at first, then oldest. Write tests/test_retry_policy.py.

nodes.title: Restart recovery
nodes.goal: Implement SPEC.md 'Restart recovery' in jobrunner/recovery.py recover, which Runner.__init__ already calls: every RUNNING job becomes CANCELLED if cancel_requested is set; otherwise the interruption counts as a failure: PENDING with next_run_at = now + backoff_delay(base_delay, attempts) and a last_error saying it was interrupted while attempts < max_attempts, else FAILED. Use JobStore.update_progress. Write tests/test_restart_recovery.py.

nodes.title: Cancellation of running jobs
nodes.goal: Complete SPEC.md 'Cancellation' without touching run_once: in jobrunner/cancellation.py request_cancel sets cancel_requested on a RUNNING job; in jobrunner/store.py JobStore.finish turns a job whose cancel_requested is set into CANCELLED, discarding the result and any retry. Write tests/test_cancel.py.

nodes.title: REST API for cancellation and retry status
nodes.goal: Extend jobrunner/api.py as SPEC.md 'REST API' requires: add POST /jobs/<id>/cancel (200 with the job, 404 for an unknown id, 409 when Runner.cancel raises InvalidTransition) and make sure job JSON (Job.to_dict) includes attempts, max_attempts, next_run_at, last_error, and cancel_requested. Keep the existing routes and error format. Write tests/test_api_status.py covering the new route and fields.

nodes.title: Dashboard columns and cancel form
nodes.goal: Change jobrunner/dashboard.py render_jobs as SPEC.md 'Dashboard' requires: columns ID, Kind, Status, Attempts (attempts/max_attempts), Next retry (next_run_at with one decimal for a PENDING job with attempts > 0, otherwise '-'), and Actions (the cancel form for PENDING and RUNNING jobs, empty otherwise). Keep HTML escaping. Write tests/test_dashboard_status.py.

nodes.title: Integration and end-to-end tests
nodes.goal: Write tests/test_end_to_end.py exercising SPEC.md end to end through the REST API and the dashboard: flaky jobs retried to success, cancellation of pending and running jobs, and a restart (a new JobStore and Runner on the same database file) recovering waiting and interrupted jobs. Fix any mismatch between modules that these tests reveal.
